verses.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੁਇ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਕਹਤ ਨ ਆਏ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: prem ras a(n)mirat nidhaan paan pooran hui akath kathaa binodh kahat na aae hai ||

en.bdb: The union between Guru and Sikh is full of pleasure and happiness. It cannot be described. By the strenuous practice of meditation on the Guru blessed Naam and by relishing the elixir of love, a Sikh feels totally satiated.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਿਆਨ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਬਿਸਿਮਰਨ ਕੈ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਦੇਹ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ਬਿਸਮਾਏ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: giaan dhiaan siaan simaran bisimaran kai bisam bidheh bisamaadh bisamaae hai ||

en.bdb: Forgetting the worldly boasts of knowledge, involvements, wisdoms and other achievements, practicing the Simran strenuously, a Sikh loses the awareness of his existence and he merges in the astonishing of astonishing state.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਪਰਮਾਦਿ ਅਰੁ ਅੰਤ ਕੈ ਅਨੰਤ ਭਏ ਥਾਹ ਕੈ ਅਥਾਹ ਨ ਅਪਾਰ ਪਾਰ ਪਾਏ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: aadh paramaadh ar a(n)t kai ana(n)t bhe thaeh kai athaeh na apaar paar paae hai ||

en.bdb: By reaching the high divine state and becoming one with the Lord who is beyond the beginning, and even the eons, a Sikh goes beyond the beginning and end. He becomes unfathomable and because of his oneness with Him, his extent cannot be comprehended.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਬੀਸ ਇਕ ਈਸ ਈਸ ਸੋਹੰ ਸੋਈ ਦੀਪਕ ਸੈ ਦੀਪਕ ਜਗਾਇ ਹੈ ॥੮੬॥
verses.translit_en: gur sikh sa(n)dh mile bees ik iees iees soha(n) soiee dheepak sai dheepak jagai hai ||86||

en.bdb: This union of Guru and Sikh surely makes a Sikh like God Himself. This union makes him dwell in His name. He perpetually utters-Thou! Thou! Lord! Lord! and he enlightens the beacon of Naam. (86)
